If you wish to take part in a reward match, you
will need to secure a Challenger’s Ticket.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Please earn yourself Ticket Points by taking part
in battles in the Infinite Z-A Royale’s battle zones.

Ah, yes, I see you have a Challenger’s Ticket.
Would you like to take part in a reward match?
Yeah, let’s do this!
Um, no thanks...
Then let’s see who your opponent will be!

All right! Let me call your opponent to the battle
court, and then you two may begin at once.

What a shame... Please come try again once you
earn yourself another Challenger’s Ticket.

Congratulations! You’ve now claimed victory in
<U+0010><U+0003>Ȇ<U+0002>, reward match<U+0010><U+0003>ᄁ<U+0002>Ȁes!
Here is your reward!

Come back and try your hand at another reward
match when you get another Challenger’s Ticket.

Check in for reward
matches here! <U+0010><U+0002>봊

Quasartico Inc. is here to
support the city’s growth.

Nothing like a match against the best Trainer I
know to get me and my Pokémon all fired up!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0006>

Nothing’s more fun for me and my team than a
match against the best Trainer I know!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0005>

Detective Emma, protector of peace and justice in
Lumiose, reporting for battle!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0008>

My Pokémon and I aren’t alone—my old mentors
have our backs in spirit!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0008>

A battle seems like the most fitting way to show
how grateful I am to you, don’t you think?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

All right, Scrafty! Let’s wield your Mega-Evolved
power to the maximum!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

Well, I can still beat you when it comes to fashion
and sewing!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

Get ready to check out Mega Starmie’s dance
moves!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000C>

C’mon, Starmie! Let’s show ’em how we get on
the good foot!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000C>

I’m still grateful to my big bro for inspiring me to
be a dancer!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000C>

Hmm. I suppose this is the first time we’ve faced
each other on equal footing as participants.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000E>

Show us both what you’ve learned over your long
life, Drampa! I have complete faith in you!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000E>

Very good. I could feel from you the strength and
steadfastness of the Trainer who saved our city.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000E>

I gotta win the Infinite Z-A Royale so DYN4MO
can start hostin’ our video game tourneys!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000F>

From Tynamo to DYN4MO, me and Eelektross are
charged and rarin’ to go!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000F>

Well, losing ain’t that bad. Gotta give fans an
underdog to cheer for, y’know?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000F>

Ya might’ve beaten my finest scaffolding course,
but let’s see if yer battlin’ skills are up to snuff!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0010>

Come on, Excadrill! Time to show this kid what
yer drill can do!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0010>

Soon as I get the chance, I’m gonna build an even
trickier course! Till then, I’ll keep on trainin’!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0010>

Was Prism Tower the reason why wild Pokémon
started flocking to Lumiose in the first place?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0011>

Falinks! Let us break through the bounds of
justice with Mega Evolution!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0011>

If Pokémon ever run riot again in Lumiose, do not
fear! I will protect the people!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0011>

Why do I battle in the Z-A Royale...? Because I
prefer the night...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>
Chandelure... Mega Evolve and burn it all...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>

Actually...I battle in the Z-A Royale to keep an eye
on Ivor...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>

If I want to make Lumiose a better city, I need to
win. If I have to bend some rules for that, I will!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0013>
Let’s show them how we do things, Scolipede!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0013>

If I can become the strongest of all, then I’ll be
able to get folks to do even more work for me.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0013>

Would defeating you please the boss...or anger
him? I wonder...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0014>
Let’s go, Skarmory. Help me fight like a man.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0014>

I do not enjoy being defeated by you, but at least
maybe I avoided the boss’s ire.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0014>

The Infinite Z-A Royale is a fine event, but it goes
without saying that nothing pleases the public<U+0010><U+0001>븀
more than my own terrific tournaments!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0015>

It is our responsibility as elites to guide the
masses, Clefable!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0015>

I have a brilliant idea: a Clefable-only tournament
to determine the strongest Clefable!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0015>

The Infinite Z-A Royale is great... It helps me
forget about Lady Jacinthe...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

Time for our secret weapon! Mega Evolve so we
can drag this kid, Dragalge!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

Throwing down with you is great, too... Another
welcome distraction from Lady Jacinthe...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

The day that the ultimate weapon was fired, all
the color was bleached from our lives...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Funny how fitting it was—my old codename of
Gris. Of course my life ended up gray as ash.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I’m going to take back the color when I
defeat you in battle!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0017>

Even if my youth was all ash and ruin, it wasn’t
wasted! Let’s light this world on fire, Charizard!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0017>

I will continue to battle on, even after this.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I battle so that others will see me for who I am—
and so I can see the true colors of this world!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0017>

If I win this time, you have to come work at
Nouveau Café as my lackey!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0018>

We’ve got to win this! Then we can get back to
serving coffee to the unfortunate!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0018>

Haaah... Nouveau Café’s become quite a hit lately,
but keeping the line moving fast is getting tough.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0018>

If they call me Le Z Éternel, that’s because Z is the
ultimate—the end to all that comes before it!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

My last Pokémon... This will be my Z, the final
letter in my challenge against you!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/

Even after finally moving up the ranks, I feel like
I’m never going to stop losing to you!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ/
Let’s get this over with.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ0
I won’t let you end this that quickly!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ0

I still haven’t given up on my dream of a Lumiose
City marathon, just so you know!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ0

You again? Shocking, considering what a “Rank X”
vibe you had back when we first met.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ1

Being pressed into a corner is what pushes me to
get serious! Don’t I sound cool when I say that?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ1

I understand why you made it all the way to
Rank A.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ1

I’m going to make Restaurant Le Nah into a three-
star restaurant! You wait and see!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ2

The sorrow of reaching the last course in a meal...
The fear of being down to your last Pokémon...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ2

At least my restaurant can say that one of its staff
battled the first Trainer to ever reach Rank A.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
That’s a reason to be famed as well, right?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ2

I, Josée—probably the fifth-strongest disciple in
the Fist of Justice—am ready to throw down!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ3

I won’t panic, even if I seem to be on the ropes.
I’ll prove I’ve learned from Ivor-sensei’s lessons!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ3

Thank you for the bout! Come by the dojo anytime
you want to work on your Plus Moves!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ3

The prodigious knowledge I have perfected as a
quiz master will have me well-suited to win this!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ5

I am certain my knowledge is impeccable, and yet
I am down to a single Pokémon...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ5

I never miss a multiple-choice quiz question, yet
choosing a correct move is surprisingly complex.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ5

What’s this? Will winning this battle make me
seem even more stylish?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ:
I’ll have my last Pokémon defeat you...with style!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ:

Don’t forget—you can become as chic as me if
you come shop at Boutique Couture!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ:

We’re so lucky—we found strong rivals in each
other, and we get to battle all out!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0006>

I’m glad we get to battle you—it lets us break
right through the limits we thought we had!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0006>

Ugh. Losing is rough...but battling you is so
much fun!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
My feelings are all over the place, but one thing I
know for sure is...you’re the best!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0006>

Lucky us, right? Not a lot of people get to have
all-out battles with their strongest rival!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0005>

I’m glad we get to battle you—it lets us break
right through the limits we thought we had!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0005>

Ugh. I can’t stand losing...but battling you is so
much fun!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
My feelings are all over the place, but one thing I
know for sure is...you’re the best!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0005>

I’m here to prove my strength as the Looker

I need to be strong if I want to keep my promise to
protect the peace in Lumiose!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0008>

I hope I can count on your help when something

After all, you’re kind of an honorary assistant
around the Looker Bureau!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0008>

Funny... It wasn’t long ago at all that I helped you

My whole party’s earned its place in Team MZ!

I’m gonna rack up wins in this Infinite Z-A Royale

Victory will be mine.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>
Chandelure... Mega Evolve for justice’s sake...<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>
I’ll get you next time.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>

Scolipede! Mega Evolve and show them all how

It’s strange the pull this city has, isn’t it? Even an

Skarmory, let’s show them how we were before

I should go report the results of our battle to

Winning in the Infinite Z-A Royale will get me the
